listening.title: Asking for leave and planning the handover

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Linh, do you have a minute? I would like to take leave next month.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Of course. Which dates are you thinking about, and how many days?

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: From the tenth to the fourteenth, plus a half day on the ninth.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: That should be fine. Do you still have enough days this year?

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Yes. I accrue one day every month, and I can also carry over three days.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Good. I can only grant leave after the campaign report is delivered.

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: The report will be ready on the seventh, two days before I leave.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Then who will be your substitute for the daily social media posts?

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: Hoa agreed to do it, and she will also join the agency call on my behalf.

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Please put the schedule and the passwords on the shared drive for her.

lines.speaker: Nam (Marketing Executive)
lines.text: I will. Can we block out Friday afternoon to walk through everything together?

lines.speaker: Linh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Yes, three o'clock works for me. Send Hoa the invitation as well.
